title: The next chapter for AI in the EU
summary: OpenAI launches the EU Economic Blueprint 2.0 with new data, partnerships, and initiatives to accelerate AI adoption, skills, and growth across Europe.
body: OpenAI launches the EU Economic Blueprint 2.0 with new data, partnerships, and initiatives to accelerate AI adoption, skills, and growth across Europe.
summaryZh: OpenAI正式发布了《EU Economic Blueprint 2.0》，推出了全新的数据支持、行业合作伙伴关系以及专项倡议，旨在全面加速欧洲地区的人工智能技术采用、数字化技能培训以及经济增长。原始信息显示：OpenAI launches the EU Economic Blueprint 2.0 with new data, partnerships, and initiatives to accelerate AI adoption, skills, and growth across Europe.。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“The next chapter for AI in the EU”。其重要性主要体现在：OpenAI发布欧盟经济蓝图2.0，展示了其在欧洲推进大模型普及和产业生态合作的最新战略。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
